messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] shinyapps.io session
parts:
Hi David,
The model for running on shinyapps.io is different than Spark. Whereas Spark configured an RStudio server to allow you to do the work right on the server, shinyapps presumes that you will get the work done anywhere, and you will deploy your application to production.

I would recommend starting up your R process (base R or through the IDE), install the packages that are recommended, and when you have your app ready for deployment, you can deploy it directly from the console.  

Hope this helps
Tareef
